title: funcd local API kind: flow
[Worker] blue right code: Function code | ctx calls shim: Shim [/]
local: Local API | a socket per worker @blue
[Provider facets] green kvf: kv | KV blobf: blob | Buckets sqlf: sql | SQL databases secretf: secret | Secrets [/]
[Built in] blue right invokef: invoke, fetch | over a link healthf: health | binding check [/]
cedarq: Cedar allows? | kv, s3, sql, link actions @purple rbacq: RBAC allows? | Secret reads @purple served: Served | the store or another Function @green refused: Refused | 403 Forbidden @red
